powers.name: Cube of Force
powers.text: Once per dawn, the trident acts as a Cube of Force's fifth face.

sentience.purpose: to spread the worship of the sea god

summary: +3 trident of the sea: water breathing, a swim speed, and Critical Hits that drain half the target's vitality.
text: Held within the dungeon of White Plume Mountain, this trident is an exquisite weapon engraved with images of waves, shells and sea creatures. You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you score a Critical Hit with it, the target takes extra Necrotic damage equal to half its Hit Point maximum. The weapon also functions as a Trident of Fish Command and a Weapon of Warning. It can confer the benefit of a Cap of Water Breathing while you hold it, and you can use it as a Cube of Force by choosing the effect instead of pressing a face. While you hold it, you can breathe underwater and swim at 60 feet. It is sentient (Intelligence 14, Wisdom 10, Charisma 18) and devoted to a god of the sea.
